name: Thanos Simulator: Infinity Gauntlet (BETA)
desc:
Master the Infinity Gauntlet. DOOMSDAY is near...

An independently developed simulator. A solo passion project started in 2025.

V 0.6.3 — Snap Update
- Added Snap ability.
- Improved mainland terrain and stone paths.
- Added waystones, broken pillars and decorations.
- Various improvements and bug fixes.

V0.6.2 — Valkyrie Update

Defeat the 3 Valkyries located inside the caves to unlock Mjolnir.

---------

Defeat enemies, unlock all six Infinity Stones and rebirth.

Power | Space | Reality | Time | Soul | Mind

Each Stone has unique abilities and its own world.

Controls:
M1 — Attack
Q/E/R/T — Abilities
F — Block
1–6 — Select Stones

Stormbreaker: Q/M2 — Aim | Q/R — Recall

V0.6 BETA - This game is currently in development, so bugs and issues may be expected unfortunately. Please provide feedback if you do come across any. There are many more story/lore related features coming out in future updates, in addition to more weapons and tools.

llm.loop: defeat enemies -> collect Infinity Stones with unique abilities and worlds -> unlock weapons -> rebirth
llm.objectives: unlock all six Infinity Stones and weapons
unique: Marvel Infinity Stone power sets per world
